content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) at a Glance

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER)
An implementation research study on developing a high-quality patient-centric integrated model for emergency care systems in selected districts of India
6 months (extended up to one year based on satisfactory performance)
26/10/2026 (Last date for sending application by email by 4:30 PM)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification includes 1 vacancy for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) post under the ICMR-funded project in the Department of Emergency Medicine & Trauma.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) post must fulfil the essential qualifications and age criteria specified by the institute. Masters in Public Health (MPH) or MSc Public Health MSc Epidemiology MSc Clinical Research MSc Nursing A relevant master's in Health Sciences or Health Services Research Good communication skills in Tamil & English Research experience (one year) in the field of emergency care or qualitative research experience in a relevant field will be given priority Experience in working in projects/programs at the State level Skills in planning and conducting research/survey-related training programmes Willingness to travel to urban and rural health facilities in the district of Pondicherry for data collection Undertaken health-related field-based data collection Ability to plan and coordinate field-based activities The maximum age limit is up to 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) position is Rs. 67,200/- per month, which includes Rs. 56,000/- plus Rs. 11,200/- (20% HRA). The likely duration of the engagement is 6 months, which may be extended up to one year based on the satisfactory performance of the candidate and at the discretion of the Project Investigator. No other allowances or facilities other than the consolidated salary shall be extended.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be expected to perform the following duties and responsibilities: Oversees the research and handles communications with State and District officials, and ICMR on a regular basis Coordinates the formative research, outcome assessment, and implementation of the project Training, guiding, and supervising Project Staff in their day-to-day work Conducts good literature search and synthesis, data management, data analysis, and report writing Performs any other related work assigned Demonstrates an ability to work in a team

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Fill out the prescribed application form attached with the notification. Prepare a single PDF file containing the filled application form along with your CV and supporting documents. Name the PDF file strictly in the format: “Candidate name_post-name_year_application” (e.g., “John_PRS I_2026_application”). Mention the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Email the complete application package to the official email ID: [email protected] on or before 26/10/2026 by 4:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in their application CV and documentary proofs provided. The list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection process consists of two stages: Written test: Tests knowledge on Public Health, Emergency Care, and Implementation Research. Interview: Assesses the ability to liaise with different and multiple organisations at State/National Level. Interviews will be conducted in person at the Department of Emergency Medicine and Trauma, JIPMER Puducherry, and the date and time will be notified one week in advance.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this JIPMER recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name is Project Research Scientist — I (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for sending complete applications by email is 26/10/2026 by 4:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master’s in Public Health (MPH), MSc Public Health, MSc Epidemiology, MSc Clinical Research, MSc Nursing, or a relevant master's in Health Sciences or Health Services Research, along with good communication skills in Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the consolidated salary offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 67,200/- per month, which includes Rs. 56,000/- plus Rs. 11,200/- (20% HRA).

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must email the filled application form along with their CV and supporting documents scanned into a single PDF file to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting based on CV and application details, followed by a written test and an in-person interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job at JIPMER?
faq.answer: No, this position is purely on a contract basis for an externally sponsored ICMR project, and the engaged person will have no claim to any regular post in JIPMER at any time.

faq.question: Q10. What should be written in the email subject line and PDF file name?
faq.answer: Candidates must mention the name of the post applied for in the email subject line and name the PDF file as “Candidate name_post-name_year_application” (e.g., “John_PRS I_2026_application”).
